prompt: The sign-in form (app/components/auth/SignIn.vue, at /login) submits anything. Validate it on submit: an empty or malformed email shows "Enter a valid email address" under the Email field, and a password shorter than 8 characters shows "Password must be at least 8 characters" under the Password field. Each error goes away as soon as its field is fixed. A valid form behaves as today.

constraints.text: Validated the way the app's other forms are (its form components with a schema), shown with the app's own field and message styles.
No colour, size or spacing typed by hand: the theme's tokens and Tailwind's scale only.
Both errors, one fixed, in the dark theme and in a narrow window.
Each error is tied to its field and announced; the fields keep their labels; focus goes to the first field in error.
Only the sign-in form changes; the sign-up form is unchanged, and no test is removed.
